summary.name: Kaiber
summary.one_liner: Kaiber is an AI video and image generation platform aimed at musicians, known for turning a song into a beat-synced music video.
use_cases: turn a song into a music video
make beat-synced videos from images or clips
restyle or edit images and video
build multi-shot AI videos on a canvas
summary.what_it_does:
Kaiber lets users upload a music track along with images, clips, or a long video and generates beat-synced videos from them, with the Beat Sync feature producing up to 10 videos in minutes. The page says Beat Sync needs no prompting. Kaiber Canvas offers curated workflows and access to several third-party models, including Grok Imagine, Nano Banana, and Kling 3.0, for generating and editing images and video. The site also lists a sample gallery of styles and formats and tutorial resources on video editing, image restyling, and lyric videos.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
notable: Beat Sync generates up to 10 beat-synced videos from images, clips, or long video without prompting
Kaiber Canvas workflows combine multiple leading AI models in one place
caveats: Access is offered as a paid trial of $5 for 5 days; ongoing pricing is not stated on the page
Platform availability beyond the web is not stated
